School y: I have priority 1. In the worst case, I will be tentatively accepted.
School z: I have priority 2. In the worst case, someone else with priority 1 will be tentatively accepted.

Therefore, in the worst case, I'm guaranteed to be tentatively accepted by schools w and y. Thus, the minimum set of schools I could be matched with is {w, y}. My ranking should prioritize my true preferences within this set, and then consider the other schools.

Therefore, my ranking should be w > y > z > x.
